source: 810 Learning is my Hobby
target: 810 Discere est otium meum

source: Thinking that if it were truly dangerous and beyond her ability to help, Madam Judgment would surely protect her, Franca pulled out a sheet of pure white paper and began her reply: “Dear Madam Judgment, “If Mr. Star’s requests are within reason, I have no problem with them.”
target: Cogitans, si vere periculosum esset atque ultra eius facultatem ad auxilium agendum, Domina Iudicii eam certe protegeret, Franca charta purae albae evolvit et suum responsum scribere coepit: “Cara Domina Iudicii, ‘Si petitiones Domini Star ratione congruentes sunt, nullam difficultatem habeo.’”

source: After writing this, Franca read the rest of Madam Judgment’s letter:
target: Post hoc scripto, Franca reliquam epistulam Dominae Iudicii legit:

source: “The Demoness of Black’s description and speculation about the Primordial Demoness are a common view within the Demoness Sect.
target: “Descriptio et speculatio Daemonissae Nigrae de Daemonissa Primordiali sunt visio communis intra Sectam Daemonissarum.

source: However, if it were that simple, things wouldn’t be this complicated.
target: Attamen, si ita simplex esset, res non tam complicatae essent.”

source: “Many high-ranking witches believe the mirror world is vital for the Demoness pathway.
target: “Multae magae summi ordinis credunt mundum specularum esse vitalem ad viam daemonissae.

source: This isn’t entirely inaccurate, but as a collective concept of ‘doors’, the mirror world seems incapable of bearing such importance.
target: Hoc non omnino inexactum est, sed ut conceptus communis “ianuarum”, mundus specularum videtur non posse talem pondus sustinere.

source: “These are things we need to understand further.
target: “Haec sunt quae ulterius cognoscenda sunt.

source: “Two of Cups, I know this may be harsh, but you still need to continue infiltrating the Demoness Sect for a while.
target: “Duo Poculorum, scio hoc fortasse asperum esse, sed tamen necesse est ut per aliquod tempus in sectam daemonissarum infiltrare pergas.

source: You are currently our highest-ranked member within the sect.
target: Nunc es membrum sectae nostri summo gradu.

source: “Due to the peculiarities of the Demoness pathway, we cannot actively cultivate male Assassins, and the existing Demoness Sect members are mentally twisted, longing to approach the Primordial One.
target: “Propter singulares vias daemonissae, non possumus Assassinos masculos active colere, et membra sectae daemonissarum existantia mentibus corruptis sunt, ad Primordiale appropinquare desiderantes.

source: We can only passively wait and find people like you who inadvertently enter the Assassin pathway…
target: Nobis solum licet passive exspectare et invenire homines similes tibi, qui inattente in viam Assassinorum incidunt…

source: Suddenly feeling a heavy sense of responsibility… Franca muttered to herself, sighed, and continued writing her reply.
target: Subito gravem sensum responsabilitatis sentiens, Franca sibi ipsi murmurat, suspiravit, et responsum scribere continevit.

source: She wasn’t too disappointed, still hoping to obtain the main ingredients for the Demoness of Despair within the sect, provided she found a way to bypass the cruel requirements of the advancement ritual.
target: Non valde deiecta erat, tamen spem habens principales materias pro Daemonissa Desperationis intra sectam adipisci, dummodo viam inveniret ut crudeles exigentias ritu progressus superaret.

source: After sending her reply, Franca leaned back in her chair, gazing idly out the window at the night sky.
target: Postquam responsum misit, Franca in sella sua recubuit, per fenestram ad nocturnum caelum otiose contemplans.

source: Suddenly, the area in front of her grew extremely dark, and a silver skull emerged from the void, holding a letter in its mouth.
target: Subito, area ante eam valde obscurata est, et calvaria argentea ex vacuo apparuit, epistulam in ore tenens.

source: Another letter?
target: Altera epistula?

source: What’s going on?
target: Quid fit?

source: Franca took it, thanked the messenger, and watched it leave before opening the letter, inhaling its subtle, enduring fragrance:
target: Franca eam accepit, nuntio gratias egit, et eam discedentem aspexit, antequam epistulam aperiret, odor subtilis atque diuturnus ejus inspirans.

source: “Dear Muggle,
target: “Care Muggle,

source: “Do you remember the previous invitation?
target: “Meministine invitationem priorem?

source: “We’re having an offline gathering in Trier this Saturday at 10 p.m. Are you still interested in attending? If so, please reply promptly, and I’ll inform you of the location and participation details.
target: “Hac Saturni die in Trier conventum praesentem habebimus ad horam decimam vespertinam. Num adhuc interest tibi ut adsis? Si ita, quaeso cito responde, et locum ac singula participationis tibi indicabo.

source: “Professor.”
target: “Professor.”

source: An offline meeting of the Academy team?
target: Conventus praesentis turmae Academiae?

source: Lumian’s life is so eventful!
target: Vita Lumiani tam eventibus plena est!

source: I’ve barely been his proxy for a few days, and I’m already swamped with tasks, one after another…
target: Vix paucos dies eius procurator fuī, et iam onerata sum officiis, unum post alium…

source: Should he be called 007?
target: Num eum 007 vocari debet?

source: Even 007 needs sleep; he doesn’t!
target: Etiam 007 somnum requirit; ille autem non habet!

source: Franca couldn’t help but lampoon.
target: Franca non potuit non irridere.

source: She had already noticed that wherever Lumian went, hidden catastrophes erupted one after another.
target: Iam animadvertit quod, ubicumque Lumian iret, catastrophae occultae una post aliam erumpebant.

source: But since she hadn’t been directly involved in most of them, the impact hadn’t been as apparent.
target: Sed quia in plurimis non directe versata erat, effectus non tam evidens fuit.

source: Now, as his liaison, she felt it keenly.
target: Nunc, ut eius legata, id vehementer sensit.

source: After a while, Franca sighed.
target: Post aliquod tempus, Franca suspiravit.

source: She’d have to use the Ice Amulet to contact Lumian again!
target: Oportet ut Amuletum Glaciale ad Lumian denuo contactum adhibeat!

source: Since obtaining it from the Demoness of Black, she hadn’t used it for investigating the Mirror People, spending it all on Lumian-related matters.
target: Ex quo id ab Daemonissa Nigra adepta est, non usus est id ad investigandum Populum Specularum, totum negotium ad res Lumianas expendens.

source: She needed to ask Lumian if he wanted to attend the offline gathering of the Academy team, which might include members of the Moses Ascetic Order.
target: Debebat Lumiano rogare num conventui praesentis turmae Academiae, qui fortasse membra Ordinis Asceticorum Moysi includere possit, interesse vellet.

source: If he did, he’d need to designate a substitute and try to send out the Lie earrings.
target: Si ita fecerit, necesse erit ut subsitutum designes atque coneris “Lie Earrings” mittere.

source: Franca quickly wrote a letter regarding the matter, wrapping a copper coin, some wraith dust, and her rarely used Beatrice’s Necklace in the paper.
target: Franca celeriter epistulam de re scripsit, et in charta involvit monetam cupram, pulverem umbraticum, atque Monile Beatricis, raro usitatum.

source: She had noticed that after passing through the seal of Morora, Lumian’s letters lost their physical form, leaving only pure information.
target: Animadvertit postquam per sigillum Mororae transierunt, epistolae Lumiani formam physicam amisse, relinquentes solam puram notitiam.

source: So, she planned to experiment, seeing if ordinary items, highly spiritual items, and Beyonder items could all pass through the seal and in what state they would exist.
target: Ita consilium ceperat experimentum facere, ut perspiceret utrum res ordinariae, res valde spirituales, et res Beyonder per sigillum transire possent, atque in quo statu existerent.

source: The experiment’s results would determine if the Lie earrings could be sent out.
target: Eventus experimenti determinabunt num “Lie Earrings” miti possint.

source: If it weren’t for the fact that each mystical item was precious and useful, Franca would have included items containing Beyonder characteristics in this experiment.
target: Nisi quod quilibet res mystica pretiosa et utilis esset, Franca res cum proprietatibus Beyonder in hoc experimento includuisset.

source: After preparing the small package, Franca walked to the full-length mirror in the living room, putting on the Ice Amulet.
target: Postquam parvum sarcinam paravit, Franca ad speculum totum in conclavi ambulavit, Amuletum Glaciale induens.

source: As it flashed with crystalline cold light, Franca pressed the package into the glass surface.
target: Cum luce gelida crystallo micante, Franca sarcinam in superficiem vitrei premebat.

source: Late at night in Morora, on the second floor of the Carnivore bar.
target: Sero nocte in Morora, in secundo tabulato tabernae Carnivorum.

source: Lumian sat under a glowing white fireball, focused on reading “Examples of Underground Mausoleum Construction.”
target: Lumian sub globulo ignis albo fulgente sedebat, responsum “Exempla Constructionis Mausolei Subterranei” legere intentus.

source: Suddenly, he looked up, his eyes bloodshot, and glanced at the mirror in the room.
target: Subito surrexit, oculis rubentibus, et speculum in conclavi aspexit.

source: The mirror’s surface had turned dark, with ripples moving within it.
target: Superficies speculi obscurata erat, cum undae intra eam moverentur.

source: Lumian reluctantly set down his book, approached the mirror, and placed his right hand on it.
target: Lumian, vix nolens, librum deponit, ad speculum accessit, et dextram manum super eum posuit.

source: He saw Intisian words appearing on the mirror’s surface, line after line, densely packed.
target: Vidit verba Intisiana in superficie speculi apparire, versus post versus, densi aggregati.

source: Professor’s invitation… Academy team’s offline gathering… experiment with transferring items…
target: Invitatio Professoris… conventus praesentis turmae Academiae… experimentum de rebus transferendis…

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani festinanter currentes erant.

source: Taking advantage of the Ice Amulet’s active effect, he reached into the mirror and pulled out an item.
target: Effectum activum Amuletī Glacialis adhibens, Lumian in speculum se intulit et rem extraxit.

source: It was a diamond necklace.
target: Erat monile adamanteum.

source: Beatrice’s Necklace!
target: Monile Beatricis!

source: The copper coin and wraith dust mentioned in Franca’s letter were gone.
target: Moneta cuprea et pulveris umbratici, quae in epistula Francae dicta erant, evanuerant.

source: Lumian looked back at the mirror, seeing an image of the coin and wraith dust around the densely packed words, with a ghostly presence.
target: Lumian speculum redegit, et imaginem monetae atque pulveris umbratici circa verba densissime congregata conspiciens, cum praesentia phantastica.

source: As the Ice Amulet’s power waned, and the words faded, the items gradually disappeared.
target: Dum potentia Amuletī Glacialis decrescebat, et verba evanescebant, res paulatim evanuebant.

source: Only pure information and items with Beyonder power can pass through that special mirror world, through the seal, and reach here?
target: Solum pura notitia et res cum potentia Beyonder praeditae per illum mundum specularum speciale, per sigillum, huc pervenire possunt?

source: Hmm, items with godhood shouldn’t work either, only something made within Morora…
target: Hmm, res cum deitate praeditae quoque non operari debent, solum aliquid intra Mororam confectum…

source: Lumian played with Beatrice’s Necklace, using the Ice Amulet’s remaining power to send Franca two words: “Necklace, okay.”
target: Lumian Monile Beatricis lusus est, reliqua potentia Amuletī Glacialis adhibens, Francae duo verba mittere: “Monile, bene.”

source: The aqueous glow within the mirror quickly receded, and the dark glass returned to normal.
target: Lumen aquosum intra speculum celeriter recedebat, et vitrum obscurum ad ordinem rediit.

source: Soon, the mirror showed another anomaly.
target: Mox, speculum aliam anomaliam ostendit.

source: This time, Franca sent the Ice Amulet through.
target: Hoc tempore, Franca Amuletum Glaciale per speculum misit.

source: This helped Lumian conserve the use of the Mirror Cufflink—only two uses left.
target: Hoc adiuvit Lumian ut usum “Mirror Cufflink”, cui modo duo usus reliquerunt, conservaret.

source: Holding the icy talisman, Lumian began writing his reply.
target: Tenens talisman gelidum, Lumian responsum scribere coepit.

source: He detailed the experiment results and his observations on the item transfer process, then instructed Franca to attend the Academy team’s offline gathering in Trier as Muggle on his behalf.
target: Eventus experimenti ac observationes de processu translationis rerum enuntiavit, deinde Franca instruxit ut conventui praesentis turmae Academiae in Trier ut “Muggle” pro eo accederet.

source: After folding the letter and enclosing the Lie earrings and Ice Amulet, Lumian activated the latter, pressing the package into the glass mirror, sending it to Franca’s apartment mirror.
target: Postquam epistulam plicavit et “Lie Earrings” atque Amuletum Glaciale inclusit, Lumian illud activavit, sarcinam in speculum vitreum prementem, eam ad speculum habitationis Francae mittens.

source: Franca received the items, read Lumian’s letter carefully, and murmured to herself, both expectant and anxious.
target: Franca res accepit, epistulam Lumiani diligenter legit, et sibi ipsi murmurat, tam exspectans quam anxia.

source: Do I really have to pretend to be Muggle?
target: Num vere simulare debeo me esse “Muggle”?

source: Sigh, the Ice Amulet can only transmit information nine more times…
target: Suspirat, Amuletum Glaciale informationem solum novem amplius transmittere potest…

source: Meanwhile, Lumian returned to his desk and resumed reading “Examples of Underground Mausoleum Construction.”
target: Interim, Lumian ad scrinium suum rediit et lecturam “Exempla Constructionis Mausolei Subterranei” continuavit.

source: He was reluctant to rest; the more he read, the more compelling the books became.
target: Non volebat quiescere; quo magis legebat, eo magis libri eum alliciebant.

source: Of course, Lumian knew this was a sign of slight corruption.
target: Certe, Lumian sciebat hoc esse signum parvae corruptionis.

source: Just then, he heard a loud explosion.
target: Subito audivit fragorem ingentem.

source: It came from a few blocks away!
target: Venit ex paucis regionibus remotus!

source: Explosion?
target: Explosio?

source: Lumian used his Ascetic endurance to break free from the compulsion, extinguished the fireball, and moved to the window to observe outside.
target: Lumian asceticam tolerantiam suam adhibuit, compulsionem superans, globum ignis exstinxit et ad fenestram processit ut foris observarit.

source: The explosions continued, with brilliant flames illuminating the streets hundreds of meters away.
target: Explosiones perseverabant, cum fulgentes flammas vias centum metrorum distante illuminantes.

source: It was on the route from the Carnivore bar to the Church of Knowledge.
target: In via ab taberna Carnivorum ad Ecclesiam Scientiae erat.

source: Lumian saw Julie jump out of her room, landing lightly like a feather, then blending into the shadows, disappearing.
target: Lumian Iuliam ex conclavi suo exsiliantem vidit, sicut plumam leve cadentem, deinde in umbras se miscere et evanescentem.

source: Hunters causing explosions and fires?
target: Venatores, qui explosionem et ignes efficere?

source: Lumian rubbed his temples, looking reluctant.
target: Lumian tempora sua fregit, haesitans spectans.

source: He grumbled to himself, I really don’t want to get involved in your schemes and fights; I just want to study peacefully.
target: Murmuravit ad se, “Vere nolo implicari in consiliis vestris et pugnis; solum quiete studere volo.”

source: Since discovering the important knowledge in the books specified by Heraberg, he had become increasingly focused, spending all his time reading except when “acting” outside.
target: Ex quo notitiam magni momenti in libris a Heraberg nominatis invenit, factus est magis concentratus, totum tempus legens, nisi cum extra “agendo”.

source: If not for the risk of exposing the books’ importance, he would have used his special abilities to study all night.
target: Nisi periculum patefaciendi momentum librorum esset, totam noctem facultatibus specialibus ut studeret.

source: The more seriously he studied, the less he wanted to do anything else, often relying on sheer willpower and even his Ascetic abilities to break free from that mental state.
target: Quo magis serio studeret, eo minus aliud agere vellet, plerumque solida voluntate atque etiam facultatibus asceticis innitens ut ex illo statu mentis evaderet.

source: After a moment, Lumian’s expression calmed, and he muttered to himself, When I find the opportunity to eliminate you all, I can finally study in peace…
target: Post paulum, vultus Lumiani quietus factus est, et ipse sibi susurravit: “Cum occasionem inveniam vos omnes tollendi, tandem in pace studere potero…”

source: Suppressing his abnormal emotions, Lumian transformed into a shadow creature, slipping into the darkness between buildings and heading toward the explosion site.
target: Suppressis perturbationibus abnormalibus, Lumian in creaturam umbratam se transformavit, inter aedificia in tenebris se infundens atque ad locum explosionis profectus est.

source: Soon, he reached the destination and saw a half-collapsed building- Dades Agricultural Company.
target: Mox ad destinatum pervenit et aedificium semiruptum vidit: Societatem Agriculturam Dades.

source: Wanak’s Dades Agricultural Company? Someone attacked Wanak?
target: Societas Agriculturalis Dades Wanak? Aliquis Wanak oppugnavit?

source: Lumian snapped out of his study-induced haze, his mind suddenly alert.
target: Lumian ex nebula studii evigilavit, et mens eius subito acuta facta est.

source: He saw two giant figures emerge from the building.
target: Vidit duas figuras gigantes de aedificio apparere.

source: They were three to four meters tall, with iron-like skin and blue paint depicting clothing, each holding a giant broadsword.
target: Eorum altitudo inter tres et quattuor metra erat, cum cute quasi ferrea et pictura caerulea vestimentorum repraesentante, singuli gladium ingentem tenentes.

source: Iron soldiers? Giant iron soldiers?
target: Milites ferrei? Milites ferrei ingentes?

source: Lumian immediately recalled the iron soldiers he had seen deep in the Sauron family’s Red Swan Castle crypt.
target: Lumian statim recordatus est militum ferreorum quos in profunda crypta Castelli Cygni Rubri familiae Sauron viderat.

source: The next moment, one of the iron soldiers smashed through the collapsed wall and fixed its cold gaze on the shadow Lumian was hiding in.
target: Proximo momento, unus ex militibus ferreis per murum ruentem perrumpens, frigido aspectu in umbram, in qua Lumian latebat, stetit.

source: It charged at Lumian, raising its giant broadsword.
target: In Lumian impetum fecit, gladium ingentem levans.
